items.title: Majority of states now battling Dollar General over pricing practices
items.summary: Ten states joined the Federal Trade Commission and 20 other states in a complaint filed last month alleging deceptive pricing.

items.title: Can Dollar General Sustain Its 80% Delivery Sales Incrementality?
items.summary: Dollar General's delivery business boasts 80% sales incrementality, larger baskets and strong repeat orders. Can this momentum last as its delivery network matures?

items.title: Dollar General: Piper Sandler bullish, sees steady high-teens EPS growth
items.summary: Investing.com -- Piper Sandler upgraded Dollar General (NYSE: DG) to Overweight from Neutral and raised its price target to $170 per share in a note on Monday, telling investors that the discount retailer has a clear path to high-teens annual earnings growth over the next three years.

items.title: 30 States Are Now Suing Dollar General Over Prices at the Register
items.summary: A dollar store lives on one promise: the shelf tag matches the register. As more states pile onto the FTC's case, the real threat may not be a fine but a court order reaching into every store's daily routines.
